control_definition: team QB-run role rate by situation, shrunk toward league situation rate
cutoff_rule: the 2025 diagnostic fits 2022–2024; the forecast-target diagnostic fits 2022–2025 and scores only 2026 Weeks 1–7, with no Week 8 or later outcomes read
limitation: conditional run-role rate evaluation only; it does not use the decision-label B probability and is not a full-game same-seed SLC ablation
role_event_definition: team run attempt with a unique team-game primary QB, excluding explicit scrambles, QB dropbacks, penalties, and two-point plays; relief-QB runs excluded
style_definition: the SLC qb_run_role_style function applied to that team rate; player-v-team log-odds adjustment with the configured 20-opportunity shrinkage
